description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Dataset_Function' for generating datasets based on mathematical functions, used in graph rendering. It includes methods for initializing the dataset, calculating points, and determining extrema.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Function
classes.description: A dataset class that generates points from a mathematical function for graph plotting.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Function
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset with min/max X, function name, and number of points, then calculates extrema.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Method intentionally left empty; points are generated from the function, not added manually.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Returns the Y value by applying the stored function to a given X.

methods.name: _count
methods.description: Returns the number of points in the dataset.

methods.name: _stepX
methods.description: Calculates the interval between points along the X-axis.

methods.name: _calculateMaxima
methods.description: Calculates the minimum and maximum Y values over the range by sampling the function.
